It is presently India's 3rd longest expressway since February 2017. It was built to de-congest the older Delhi–Agra national highway (NH-2) or Mathura Road. The expressway having project value ₹ 12,839 crore (US$1.8 billion) was inaugurated on 9 August 2012 by then Chief Minister of UP Akhilesh Yadav . [ 1 ] [ 2 ] A total of 13 service roads of about 168 km have been built for local commuters to access the expressway.
